sprints.name: Foundation and Backend Architecture
sprints.goal: Establish the Express/Mongo feature-module architecture, shared common utilities, and initial certificate lifecycle API surface.

sprints.name: Search Discovery, Audit Core, and Authentication
sprints.goal: Ship public hotel search/AI recommendations, core audit + RAG document chat, JWT auth, and early trust-score/email lifecycle hooks.

sprints.name: Certificate Lifecycle Depth
sprints.goal: Deepen certificate lifecycle: activity timeline, hotel-enriched certificate reads, full update API, and trust-score fixes.

sprints.name: Owner Portal, Certificate Documents, and Release Hardening
sprints.goal: Generate/email certificate PDFs, expose owner download and admin stats, finish application/lifecycle features, and harden tests plus deployment docs for release.

tasks.title: Initialize backend repository
tasks.description: Create the initial commit and repository baseline for the ethical tourism certification backend.
acceptance_criteria: Project can be cloned and opened by the team

tasks.title: Establish feature-based backend architecture
tasks.description: Scaffold core modules, common utilities, middleware patterns, and test infrastructure (Sadeesha: architecture commit 2026-02-08).
acceptance_criteria: common/, modules/, and app entrypoints exist
Shared utilities and middleware layout are in place
Test infrastructure folder structure is ready

tasks.title: Implement initial certificate lifecycle APIs
tasks.description: Deliver the first certificate lifecycle endpoints (Chathush: 'Implemented the lifecycle apis', 2026-02-17).

tasks.title: Define shared User and Hotel models
tasks.description: Place shared Mongoose models in common/models for use across certification, audit, and search modules.
acceptance_criteria: User model supports Admin, Hotel Owner, Auditor, Tourist roles
Hotel model is reusable across modules

tasks.title: Enhance hotel search and AI recommendations
tasks.description: Improve hotel recommendation scoring with feedback summaries and search/feedback service logging (Nipun: AI-Recommendation + logging commits, 2026-02-26).

tasks.title: Add Vercel serverless deployment entrypoint
tasks.description: Add vercel.json and api/index.js; fix Node runtime/builds (Nipun: deployment commits, 2026-02-26).
acceptance_criteria: Vercel config uses a supported Node runtime

tasks.title: Implement audit management and RAG document chat
tasks.description: Create audit endpoints (create/retrieve/review/compliance), document processing, and hotel-data chatbot (Eric: audit feature commits, 2026-02-26).
acceptance_criteria: Audits can be created and reviewed by section

tasks.title: Refactor vector DB embeddings to MongoDB
tasks.description: Store audit document embeddings in MongoDB (Eric: vector database refactor, 2026-02-27).

tasks.title: Implement JWT registration, login, and user retrieval
tasks.description: Deliver /auth/register, /auth/login, and user retrieval (Eric: authentication system commit, 2026-04-11; Sadeesha later added Admin user listing).
acceptance_criteria: Users can register and login with JWT

tasks.title: Auto-update trust score from tourist feedback
tasks.description: When feedback is submitted, update certificate trust score and expose a trust-score update API (Chathush: 2026-02-24).
acceptance_criteria: Feedback submission updates related trust score
Trust score update API validates score bounds
Only eligible hotels can be issued certificates

tasks.title: Enable and harden CORS for frontend origins
tasks.description: Enable CORS middleware and allow local Vite ports (Sadeesha: CORS commits, 2026-04-11; Nipun refined config).

tasks.title: Add certificate activity timeline API
tasks.description: Expose ordered certificate activity history (Chathush: timeline API, 2026-03-29).

tasks.title: Return hotel data with certificate-by-id responses
tasks.description: Enrich get-certificate responses with linked hotel details (Chathush: 2026-03-29).
acceptance_criteria: Certificate payload includes hotel business info
Missing hotel references are handled safely

tasks.title: Implement full certificate update API
tasks.description: Allow authorized updates to certificate details (Chathush: full update API, 2026-04-06 — started in this sprint).
acceptance_criteria: Certificate details can be updated with validation

tasks.title: Fix trust score calculation on feedback
tasks.description: Resolve trust-score calculation issues triggered by feedback and related Mongoose connection problems (Chathush: 2026-03-29).
acceptance_criteria: Feedback no longer produces incorrect trust scores
MongoDB SRV connection issues are resolved

tasks.title: Advance hotel certification application services
tasks.description: Continue hotel CRUD, SerpAPI candidate search, and AI evaluation work in certification/application (Sadeesha: dominant cert-application ownership).

tasks.title: Maintain hotel contact discovery APIs
tasks.description: Keep contact list/search endpoints sorted by certificate level priority (Nipun: primary search module owner).

tasks.title: Add audit and section review schemas
tasks.description: Formalize Joi/Swagger schemas for audit creation and section review (Eric: audit schema commits).

tasks.title: Generate certificate PDF and email download link
tasks.description: Generate certificate PDFs from the backend and email secure download links; restyle PDF; fix download env issues (Chathush: 2026-04-07 → 2026-04-12).
acceptance_criteria: PDF includes hotel, level, trust score, and validity
Email contains a working download link

tasks.title: Implement certificate stats and charts APIs
tasks.description: Admin overview stats/charts plus eligible-hotel API upgrades (Chathush: 2026-04-09).
acceptance_criteria: Stats include counts by status and level
Eligible hotels API returns certification-ready hotels

tasks.title: Implement owner certificate management
tasks.description: Owner certificate lists, download-link API, and ownership enhancements (Sadeesha: owner certificate commits, 2026-04-11/12).
acceptance_criteria: Hotel Owner sees only their certificates
Download-link endpoint requires Hotel Owner role

tasks.title: Complete lifecycle service with trust scoring
tasks.description: Implement lifecycle service with trust scoring, automated status tracking, routes, and Swagger (Sadeesha: lifecycle service/routes, 2026-04-11).
acceptance_criteria: Trust score clamps to 0–100 and updates level

tasks.title: Ship hotel CRUD with AI evaluation and candidate search
tasks.description: Hotel controller/service with AI-driven candidate search and review evaluation; normalize candidate fields (Sadeesha: 2026-04-11).
acceptance_criteria: Hotel CRUD endpoints are available under /hotels
Candidate fields are normalized/backfilled from search

tasks.title: Add Jest unit/integration/performance suites
tasks.description: Set up Jest with audit and hotel test suites; update HotelRequest status on audit completion (Eric: 2026-04-11/12).
acceptance_criteria: Unit and integration tests run via npm scripts
Performance test configs exist for covered modules

tasks.title: Add lifecycle unit, integration, and performance tests
tasks.description: Implement lifecycle test cases (Chathush: unit/integration/performance tests, 2026-04-11).

tasks.description: Replace outdated test docs; add Search/Audit/Hotel testing instructions; add buildHotelImage Google Maps enrichment (Nipun: 2026-04-12).

Hotel data includes Google Maps image enrichment
